name: Tempestus Boarding Regiment
legend: The Militarum Tempestus excel in high-intensity, fast-moving raids. Some of their regiments further refine these specialisms towards the boarding of voidships, storming vital locations to seize and scuttle the vessel or extract vital personnel from the foe’s clutches.

rules.name: Purge-Sweep Protocols
rules.legend: Tempestus Scions are drilled to progress through voidships chamber by chamber, corridor by corridor, clearing each with blitzing firepower before sweeping on to the next.
rules.description_html: Each time a MiLiTARUM TEMPESTUS unit from your army is selected to shoot, if one or more models in that unit are within 1" of an open Hatchway and every model in that unit is on the same side of that Hatchway, select one enemy unit on the opposite side of that Hatchway from that unit. Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HiTS] ability while targeting that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: BRUTAL TRAINING
stratagems.type: Tempestus Boarding Regiment – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Tempestus Scions are trained in a range of specialist hand-to-hand combat techniques. Coupled with combat stimms, these make them bruising foes.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

stratagems.name: FIRE-PATTERN HURRICANUS
stratagems.type: Tempestus Boarding Regiment – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Emptying the magazines of their weapons in an indiscriminate hail of fire, the Scions create a zone of lethality that foes will struggle to advance into.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next Shooting phase, subtract 2 from the Move characteristic of models in that enemy unit, and subtract 2 from Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

stratagems.name: COORDINATED STRIKE
stratagems.type: Tempestus Boarding Regiment – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Employing coordinated helm chronos, the Scions execute a pre-arranged simultaneous tactical manoeuvre.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Start of your Command phase.

TARGET: One OffIcER model from your army.

EFFECT: Select one Order your model can issue. Every ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army is issued that Order (regardless of any keywords those units are normally required to have).

RESTRICTIONS: Until the end of the turn, OFFICER models from your army cannot issue Orders. You can only use this Stratagem once.

stratagems.name: LOCKDOWN
stratagems.type: Tempestus Boarding Regiment – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Voidborne Scions are trained to swiftly goad the machine spirits of bulkheads and hatches, slamming them shut in their wake to trap the foe.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, after your unit ends a move, you can select one open Hatchway it moved through during that move; close that Hatchway.

enhancements.name: Covert Breach
enhancements.legend: Moving with stealth and urgency, these Scions have already bypassed the enemy’s outer defences before their presence is even detected.
enhancements.description_html: At the start of the first battle round, the bearer’s unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
enhancements.description_text: At the start of the first battle round, the bearer’s unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".

enhancements.name: Elimination Force
enhancements.legend: Tasked with the destruction of a specific enemy asset, the Tempestus Scions focus their most lethal attentions against it as per their explicit orders.
enhancements.description_html: At the start of the first battle round, select one enemy unit. Each time a model in the bearer’s unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than the Toughness characteristic of that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
